 Community Watchlist Portfolio Search stocks, sectors, indices or pages News Energy Quick read Petrol price up by Rs1, diesel rates unchanged
 Mettis Global • 20 Nov 2026, 7:24 AM PKT • 1 min read 
 ENG اردو A- A+ Add as preferred source on Google X f Mettis Global reported that petrol will cost Rs323.00 per litre from November 20, 2026, after a Rs1.00 increase. The revision was made by the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA) under the petroleum pricing mechanism approved by the Federal Government. The change applies to the ex-depot price of Motor Spirit, the petrol category listed in the notification.
 High-Speed Diesel (HSD) remains at Rs355.00 per litre, its previous rate on November 19, 2026. The announcement therefore changes the listed petrol rate while leaving the diesel figure unchanged for the new pricing period. For investors, the adjustment is relevant to the energy sector because it updates the regulated prices of two widely used petroleum products, although the report does not name any listed company.
 At a glance
 Petrol rises by Rs1.00 to Rs323.00 per litre from November 20, 2026.
 HSD remains unchanged at Rs355.00 per litre.
 OGRA revised the ex-depot prices under the Federal Government-approved mechanism.

 The revised petrol and HSD rates are relevant to investors tracking regulated prices in the energy sector.
